content.title: About
content.content: Grilled chicken fillet is a tender, skinless piece of lean meat cooked over an open flame. It has a light smoky aroma, juicy texture, and a mildly salty flavor. Perfect for salads, sandwiches, Asian‑style dishes, and quick weeknight meals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Grilling preserves most of the protein and vitamins compared with deep‑frying.
Chicken fillet is one of the most affordable sources of high‑quality protein.
Proper marinating can boost flavor without adding extra salt.
The grill allows excess fat to drip away, reducing overall fat content.
In many cuisines grilled chicken is served with chimichurri, teriyaki, or lemon‑herb sauces.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Chicken fillet provides about 31 g of protein per 100 g, supporting muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Skinless and grilled, it contains only 3–4 g of fat per 100 g, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: It supplies niacin (B3), vitamin B6, and B12, which are essential for metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Contains minerals
items.content: Chicken fillet offers iron, zinc, and phosphorus, important for blood formation and bone health.

items.title: Promotes satiety
items.content: The high protein content helps keep you feeling full longer.

items.title: Food‑borne illness risk
items.content: Undercooked chicken may harbor salmonella; cook to an internal temperature of 75 °C (165 °F).

items.title: Poultry allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to chicken proteins.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: When using salty marinades, monitor overall sodium intake.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Slice grilled chicken fillet for salads, add to sandwiches, serve with vegetable sides, or toss into pasta. It stores well in the fridge for 3‑4 days and can be reheated or eaten cold.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Cool the fillet to room temperature, then place in an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 4 days. For longer storage, freeze in bags at –18 °C (0 °F) where it retains quality for up to 2 months.
